name: Bounce & Rhyme – Southwater Library – 15 September
description: Free drop-in nursery rhyme and action-song session for babies and toddlers under 5 with parents/carers. Runs every Tuesday 10:30–11:00 at Southwater Library. No booking needed.
age_guidance: Babies and toddlers under 5 with parent/carer

name: Telford Children’s Autism Hub – Primary Family Fun – 15 September
venue: Telford Children’s Autism Hub, Hazledine House
description: Term-time Primary Family Fun session at Telford Children’s Autism Hub, running 16:00–17:00 on the third Tuesday of each month. The Hub supports autistic children and young people and those on the autism assessment pathway, with family sessions designed to build skills, confidence and positive relationships. The current official page does not state a price or booking requirement, so neither is inferred.
age_guidance: Primary-aged autistic children / children on autism assessment pathway; service eligibility 0–18

name: Best Start Stay & Play (PEEP Learning Together) – 15 September
description: Free Stay & Play based on the PEEP Learning Together programme for parent/carers with children aged 3–4. Interactive activities, talking, singing, reading and play, with practical ideas for supporting development at home. Five Tuesday sessions run from 15 September to 13 October 2026, 10:00–11:30. A free place must be booked using the council’s link.

name: Bounce & Rhyme – Wellington Library – 15 September
description: Free drop-in nursery rhyme and action-song session for babies and toddlers under 5 with parents/carers. Runs every Tuesday 14:00–14:30 and every Thursday 10:30–11:00 at Wellington Library. No booking needed.
age_guidance: Babies and toddlers under 5 with parent/carer

name: Coffee and Chat, Stay and Play – Raven House – 15 September
description: Free weekly Early Help family drop-in every Tuesday, 09:30–12:30. Babies, toddlers and pre-schoolers can use the Stay and Play while families can get advice on parenting, money, housing and other family issues. Family support covers children 0–19 and young people with SEND up to 25. On the second and fourth Tuesdays, health visitors also offer a no-appointment clinic for ages 0–5.
age_guidance: Babies, toddlers and pre-schoolers; family support 0–19 and SEND to 25

name: Natural Play Area Open Play – The Cut – 15 September
description: Outdoor open-play session in Shropshire Wildlife Trust's Natural Play Area with mud play, tunnels, a sand pit and bug hunting. Open play runs weekdays 10:00–15:30 and Sundays 09:30–12:30. The source says additional charges apply but does not state the current open-play price.
accessibility: The visitor-centre page notes fully accessible paths in the wildlife garden; it does not give separate accessibility details for the Natural Play Area.
parking_transport: The Cut is at 193 Abbey Foregate and is beside Abbey Foregate Pay & Display car park; the visitor centre is about a ten-minute walk from Shrewsbury station and around 100m from the Old Potts Way Park & Ride stop.
age_guidance: Children; no age range stated on source

name: Museum Babies – Shrewsbury Museum & Art Gallery – 15 September
description: Weekly term-time sensory-play drop-in for non-walking babies and their parents/carers. Runs every Tuesday, 10:00–12:00, from 8 September to 20 October 2026. £3 payable on the day; no booking needed.

name: Severn Hospice Big Book Fair 2026 – Saturday
description: Severn Hospice's first Big Book Fair, with pre-loved fiction and non-fiction, children's books, vinyl records and other media. Children's area and storytime sessions; Refresh café open. Free entry and purchases support hospice care.

name: The Nag's Head
description: Make It Beautiful Theatre Company's dark comedy about three estranged siblings returning home after their father's death, with music from folk band Good Habits and real paranormal accounts. Doors 19:00, performance 19:30. Running time 105 minutes including a 20-minute interval. Adult £12; concession £10.

name: Shrewsbury 50K 2026
venue: Rectory Fields, Church Stretton to The Quarry, Shrewsbury
description: 50K ultra starting in Rectory Fields, Church Stretton, tackling the Burway climb and continuing through the Shropshire countryside to Shrewsbury. Official town council listing gives the public event window as 08:00-18:00.

name: The Pareto FM Shrewsbury Half & Metric Half Marathon
description: Shrewsbury Half & Metric Half Marathon public event, listed by Shrewsbury Town Council across various route locations.

name: Walk for Dementia plus Fairy & Pixie Trail
description: Public community event listed by Shrewsbury Town Council: Walk for Dementia plus Fairy & Pixie Trail in The Quarry.

name: Museum Ghost Tour 2026 – 31 October
description: Halloween ghost tour into museum cellars and former prison cells normally closed to the public, revealing the darker side of Shrewsbury Museum. Tour starts at 18:00 outside the museum. £17 adult, £8 child age 10-17. Suitable footwear advised because of uneven/steep steps and low ceilings.

name: Mayor of Shrewsbury's Taste of Asia
venue: Smithy's Bar, Shrewsbury Town Football Club
description: Brand-new Mayor of Shrewsbury charity food and culture event bringing together Thai, Vietnamese, Nepalese, Indian, Sri Lankan and Turkish dishes. Tickets are £20 per person and include £10 of food and drink tokens. Profits support the Mayor's four chosen charities. Latest official council notice confirms the event was moved to Sunday 18 October.

name: Birdcatcher
description: A Pentabus production in association with Papatango Theatre Company and Middle Child Theatre. Darkly comic drama about a teenage girl navigating life inside a doomsday cult. Doors 19:00, show 19:30, running time 70 minutes with no interval. Adult £12; concession £10; limited free U25 tickets.
accessibility: Audio Description is integrated into every performance. Captions/subtitles are offered at some performances on handheld Difference Engine devices.

name: Severn Hospice Big Book Fair 2026 – Sunday
description: Second day of Severn Hospice's first Big Book Fair, with pre-loved fiction and non-fiction, children's books, vinyl records and other media. Children's area and storytime sessions; Refresh café open. Free entry and purchases support hospice care.

name: Museum Ghost Tour 2026 – 30 October
description: Halloween ghost tour into museum cellars and former prison cells normally closed to the public, revealing the darker side of Shrewsbury Museum. Tour starts at 18:00 outside the museum. £17 adult, £8 child age 10-17. Suitable footwear advised because of uneven/steep steps and low ceilings.
